passages.title: Cycling in Modern Cities
passages.text: In many modern cities, cycling is becoming increasingly popular as a way to travel. Local governments are (1) ............ more money on cycle lanes so that people can ride safely. This not only helps to reduce traffic jams but also (2) ............ the air quality in busy urban areas. Many people now (3) ............ to cycle to work instead of taking the Bus or driving. However, there are still some challenges. For example, cyclists often find it difficult to find a safe place to (4) ............ their bikes. Some businesses are trying to help by providing secure parking areas. In addition, sharing schemes have (5) ............ it possible for anyone to rent a bike for a short time. This has made cycling a very (6) ............ Option for both tourists and local residents.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (1).
questions.explanation: We use the verb 'spend' with money (spend money on something). 'Pay' is followed by 'for', and 'give' or 'lose' do not fit the context of investing in infrastructure.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (2).
questions.explanation: 'Improves' means to make something better, which fits the context of air quality. 'Grows', 'makes', and 'develops' do not collocate correctly here.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (3).
questions.explanation: 'Choose' is followed by a to-infinitive ('choose to cycle'). 'Enjoy' and 'practice' require an -ing verb, and 'offer' does not make sense in this context.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (4).
questions.explanation: You 'leave' your bike in a safe place when you park it. 'Stay' and 'remain' are intransitive verbs and cannot take 'their bikes' as an object.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (5).
questions.explanation: The structure 'make it possible (for someone) to do something' is a standard English pattern. 'Done', 'kept', and 'caused' do not fit this grammatical structure.

questions.question: Choose the correct word for gap (6).
questions.explanation: 'Popular' means liked by many people, which fits the context of cycling being a good Option. 'Famous' means well-known, which is not suitable for describing a personal transport Option.
